title: Melody of the Forgotten Wall
description: A dark silhouetted female figure with flowing hair and dress stands in a cavern, reaching toward a large cracked stone wall embedded with musical staves, notes, and circular symbols. Pink petals and golden fragments float and fall around the scene against a dark, swirling background.
prompt: A solitary silhouetted woman with long flowing hair and dress stands in a dark cavern, one hand touching a massive cracked stone wall that features embedded musical notation, swirling staves, golden notes and circular symbols. Pink petals drift through the air as golden fragments break away from the wall, mysterious and melancholic atmosphere, dramatic lighting, surreal fantasy scene.
